violet: FYI onboarding sparrow24k-int4 (30k ctx). After a big prefill then forcing a mid-gen KV eviction we see nondeterministic token drift and regen NLL regressions.

sachin: Drop a minimal repro?

violet: Repro (deterministic seed):
```bash
./eval --model sparrow24k-int4 --seed 2026 --prompt tests/long_run_30k.txt --prefill 30000 --evict-token 1024 --max-toks 200
```

violet: Short log snip: 
```
[2026-03-24T09:02:10Z] shard=0 kv_idx=61439 ropescale=0.999998
[2026-03-24T09:02:10Z] shard=1 kv_idx=0     ropescale=1.000245  <-- boundary jump after stitch
[2026-03-24T09:02:11Z] token_diff=0.19 nll_up=+12.1%
```

ram: I can repro in sim; bisect points to int4 fused ropescale recompute at restore. int8 path fine.

kate: Disabling prefix cache removes divergence, so KV restore/stitch is implicated.

sachin: Hypothesis: per-shard quant rounding + small accumulator bias produce a multiplicative misalign across shard boundaries. Stitch assumes identical ropescale.

violet: Quick mitigation idea: on kv_restore compute a canonical ropescale from the first restored shard and apply a multiplicative correction to subsequent shards to align scales. Add unit test asserting post-restore continuity <1e-4.

ram: I sketched PR #1984 with the normalize-on-restore change and a tiny reproducer test tests/unit/test_stitch_ropescale.py.

ci-bot: canary/sparrow reported regen-drift threshold exceeded at 2026-03-24T09:08:00Z; canary paused.

kate: Running 5-seed smoke patched vs unpatched on GPU. Command: 
```bash
./scripts/smoke_longprefill.sh sparrow24k-int4 --pr 1984 --seeds 2026 2027 2028 2029 2030 --prefill 32000 --evict-token 512
```

ram: Early smoke: patched run ropescale diffs <4e-5, NLL returned to baseline. Uploading minimal logs to s3://redwood-ci/sparrow24k/1769012345/smoke/

violet: Plan: (1) full 20-seed eval on staging dedicated, (2) backport to runtime int4 path if clean, (3) add onboarding gate to fail on >1% regen drift for prefill+evict.

sachin: I'll add the CI gate and review PR.

violet: Thanks everyone, will follow-up when full eval completes. :thumbsup:
